$note: Lockfile for third-party skills installed under .agents/skills/. Supply-chain integrity for agent instructions is the same problem as for packages: an unpinned remote skill is arbitrary instruction injection with a YAML header. Every skill under .agents/skills/ that was NOT authored for this project must have a matching entry here, pinning where it came from and a content hash so upstream drift is detectable before it's trusted again. Skills authored for this project (compose-page, sync-changes, find-skills) are not listed here — see .agents/skills/find-skills/SKILL.md for the full provenance convention and install procedure.

skills.name: humanizer
skills.notes: Read in full before installing, per find-skills step 1: one SKILL.md, no scripts/, references/ or assets/ directories, no shell commands, no network calls, no environment reads. MIT-licensed upstream, and it credits Wikipedia's "Signs of AI writing" (WikiProject AI Cleanup) as its basis in its own Source section -- keep that attribution on any edit. `sha256` is the installed file, which differs from upstream by exactly one addition: the `metadata.source` line this repo's convention requires. `upstreamSha256` is v2.11.1's SKILL.md as published, so upstream drift stays detectable without unpicking that edit.
